name: object-type-reference-test-19fd51d776/object-type-reference-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.error lists only "message".
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" includes "error:message", but not error:detail.
Module-level declarations > Class definition: "Supports `object-field`, `method-defn` and `object-type-inclusion` members".
reason: The whole case requires unsupported lang.error detail access: testInclusionWithRemoteMethods calls err.detail() and asserts the parsing error's detail message. Although object type inclusion and remote methods are supported, this asserted behavior depends on a langlib method excluded by the explicit supported-method lists.
unsupported_constructs: err.detail()["message"] in testInclusionWithRemoteMethods: error:detail is not a supported langlib method.
test_design_notes: The unsupported detail access is executed from main and checked by assertEquality, so it is essential asserted behavior rather than output instrumentation.
